title: $L^1$ Behavior of the Stokes System and the Navier--Stokes System in the Half Space
summary: In this paper, the detailed behavior of solutions of both the Stokes and the Navier--Stokes system in the half space is investigated when the initial data belongs to $L^1$. We first give a detailed asymptotic expansion of the solution to the Stokes system supplemented with $L^1$ initial data. With the aid of this expansion, we provide two sufficient conditions on the initial data so that the associated solutions of the Navier--Stokes system do not belong to $L^1$, corresponding to long time and short time behaviors, respectively.
